findings.evidence: After lines 144–146 construct `T` and `hspan`, the substantive proof uses only `T` and `hspan`; the remaining uses of `G` merely translate membership through `Finset.image`.
findings.fix: Prove the theorem first for such a finite `T ⊆ A`, with union over `t ∈ T`, then derive the current standard-cover statement using `P.span_image_eq_extendedIdealOfDefinition G hG`.
findings.issue: `spaAnalytic_eq_biUnion_rationalSubset` is under-generalized: it requires `G : Finset P.ringOfDefinition` and generation of `P.idealOfDefinition`, while the cover argument only needs `T : Finset A` with `Ideal.span (T : Set A) = P.extendedIdealOfDefinition`.

summary: The rational-cover theorem is stated only for generators in the chosen ring of definition, although its argument naturally applies to any finite generating set of the extended ideal in A.
